title: Ericsson celebrates 1,000+ Omani learners milestone through Digital Lab at Midad Digital Center inauguration
summary: Ericsson (NASDAQ: ERIC) celebrated a significant milestone in its commitment to developing Oman’s future digital talent, with more than 1,000 young Omanis upskilled through the Digital Lab Program, during the inauguration of the Midad Digital Center at Innovation Park Muscat.
